Returns Policies Compared

Northwind Outfitters allows free returns within 60 days of delivery. Items must be unworn and have their tags attached. Refunds are made within five working days.

Coastline Clothing allows returns within 30 days, but charges a 4 pound return fee unless the item is faulty. Refunds are made within ten working days.

Both shops accept returns by post or at a drop-off point.
